assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations, dizziness, and intermittent syncope suggestive of underlying sick sinus syndrome and paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
The symptoms are intermittent in nature and require correlation of clinical events with rhythm disturbances.
A 30-day continuous ambulatory ECG monitoring study is medically necessary to evaluate arrhythmia burden and guide further management.
The diagnosis of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation is supported by code I49.5.
The diagnosis of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation is supported by code I48.91.
The diagnosis of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation is supported by code I49.9.
The 30-day continuous ambulatory ECG monitoring study corresponds to CPT code 93247.
Prolonged rhythm monitoring is required to capture intermittent episodes and correlate them with the reported clinical events.
